text:
hana_fin: FYI invoice 2026-6602 from CemTech Ltd (TR) landed in AP flagged for withholding/gross-up. Vendor asks Redwood to pay net and gross-up for any Turkish withholding. invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-6602.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-6602 flagged: missing TRC (tax residency cert) and signed gross-up addendum. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

cem_vendor: Merhaba  Cem here from CemTech. we're Turkish Ltd (MERSIS 1234567890). line items = "technical support + embedded software customization". contract clause 6 says vendor to be "made whole" for taxes. happy to upload residency docs.

miray_tax: quick clarifier: technical services can be subject to Turkish withholding for nonresidents; rate depends on classification (royalty vs service) and treaty. We need TRC from Turkish tax authority and evidence of where services performed. If Turkish resident entity, domestic WHT may not apply on inbound payments, but if beneficial owner is nonresident, WHT could apply.

hana_fin: vendor bank details? last4 IBAN? we had a misdirect last month so double-checking.

cem_vendor: IBAN ****4321  bank: Garanti BBVA. uploaded: Invoice_2026-6602.pdf and MERSIS_cert_1234567890.pdf

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: Invoice_2026-6602.pdf, MERSIS_cert_1234567890.pdf by cem_vendor

raj_legal: contract language is "vendor to be made whole" but no formula. Legal needs a signed gross-up addendum with calculation and caps before finance can commit to gross-up. We'll draft a short template.

miray_tax: additional ask: please provide TRC (Vergi Kimlik dokumu or tax residency certificate) or letter from tax office. Also state whether the service was performed physically in Turkey or remotely from engineers abroad; sourcing matters for withholding.

cem_vendor: services performed mostly in Istanbul; TRC will be uploaded. we prefer not to have 20% withheld. well upload Grossup_Addendum_signed_6602.pdf now.

invoice-bot: New file uploaded: Grossup_Addendum_signed_6602.pdf by cem_vendor

hana_fin: received addendum. finance won't auto-gross-up until legal confirms language and tax confirms statutory rate and acceptable evidence. holding payment. status -> ON_HOLD.

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by hana_fin

miray_tax: preliminary: for technical services to a US company, Turkey could impose a 20% withholding on payments to nonresidents unless reduced by treaty. US-Turkey treaty may reduce rates for certain income categories, but claim requires TRC + signed declaration and sometimes a W-8 equivalent if beneficial owner is non-US. Since CemTech is Turkish resident, TRC should support domestic treatment; however if payment routed to a non-Turkish affiliate, different rules apply. We'll review TRC once uploaded.

raj_legal: drafted addendum and inserted formula: gross-up = (withholding_amount)/(1 - withholding_rate) so vendor receives the pre-withholding amount. Also added cap = statutory withholding only and vendor to provide official tax receipt within 60 days. Vendor agreed and signed. Legal OK.

cem_vendor: uploaded TRC_6602.pdf and BankStatement_lastpage_****4321.pdf

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: TRC_6602.pdf, BankStatement_lastpage_****4321.pdf by cem_vendor

hana_fin: tax ops  confirm expected withholding % if we paid today and treaty not applied. Also confirm whether TRC + signed addendum is sufficient for payroll to release gross-up hold.

miray_tax: confirmed offline: if treaty does NOT reduce rate, domestic withholding on technical services to nonresidents can be ~20%. With TRC proving Turkish residency and services performed in Turkey, domestic withholding likely not applicable on domestic-source receipts; but because payer is US-based, US sourcing rules matter too. Conservative approach: withhold 20% at payment, simultaneously gross-up per addendum, and release gross-up portion only after vendor provides official tax payment receipt. If TRC demonstrates Turkish resident receiving payment in Turkey and tax ops confirms domestic treatment, we may not need to withhold. We'll finalize within 24hrs after reviewing TRC.

hana_fin: finance-approvals  tagging for GL/Budget approval for potential gross-up (20% cap).

invoice-bot: Finance approval required: gross-up budget impact estimate = USD 12,400 if capped at 20%. Approvals pending.

raj_legal: remind: addendum requires vendor to refund any excess gross-up if tax authority later rules no withholding required. clause present.

cem_vendor: understood and accepted conditions. we will provide official tax payment receipt if withholding charged.

hana_fin: summary & next steps: (1) tax finalizes review of TRC (expected 24hrs) (2) legal and vendor addendum signed (done) (3) finance-approvals to OK budget if gross-up needed (4) payment held until confirmation. we'll update thread when tax completes.

[later same thread]

invoice-bot: Tax note added to invoice 2026-6602: "TRC received; tax ops to confirm withholding application. Payment on hold."

miray_tax: final note: TRC confirms Turkish residency and services performed in Turkey. For US payer, withholding on cross-border technical services is a nuanced source question; however, tax ops recommends paying without withholding if vendor provides TRC and confirms Turkish bank (both satisfied). Recommend no withholding and release payment. Keep TRC + addendum in file for audit.

hana_fin: finance-approvals confirmed budget neutral (no gross-up needed). releasing payment and marking invoice CLEARED. thanks everyone.

cem_vendor: thank you  appreciate the quick turnaround. please confirm payment eta.

hana_fin: scheduled for next AP run (2 business days).

invoice-bot: Thread archived: "TRC & addendum received; tax released payment without withholding; invoice CLEARED."
